about.heading: I design, build and connect.
about.bio1: I’m a Senior Product Engineer and founder of Ultramare.dev. I bring more than 5 years of digital product experience, a mobile focus on Flutter and Dart, and over 15 years in visual design and branding.
about.bio2: I work from strategy and UX/UI through architecture, backend and App Store and Google Play releases. I build real-time systems with Cloudflare, Supabase and WebSockets, and apps with BLoC, Riverpod and Clean Architecture.
about.bio3: I also build automations and multi-agent systems: GoHighLevel, Hermes, MCP and agent harnesses to connect tools, models and workflows.
about.bio4: Based in Venezuela and working remotely in Spanish and English (C1), I bring design, engineering and business together.
